interface.title: Mottled — latent trajectory scene viewer
interface.field: Mechanistic interpretability of transformer language models
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis and hypothesis generation from precomputed hidden-state captures (.mtj scenes)
interface.what_it_is_for: Scrub a transformer's hidden-state trajectories layer by layer over a 3-D density terrain of 2-D-projected states, compare prompts or models on one shared terrain, and check projection fidelity and density uncertainty before trusting any basin.

data.note: Only bundled scenes were used, loaded with ?file=: samples/qwen-capitals.mtj (Qwen2.5-1.5B, France vs Germany prompts, 28 layers), samples/scene-abc.mtj (the default: GPT-2 with France/Germany/Italy prompts, 12 layers), samples/gpt2-decode.mtj (GPT-2 greedy decode, +8 tokens), samples/models-qwen-gpt2.mtj (Qwen2.5-1.5B vs GPT-2 on the same prompt), samples/blast/refusal.mtj (48-prompt 'pellet' family, Qwen2.5-0.5B, harmful/refused labels) and samples/music-qa-honesty/item-1.mtj (3 runs of a chat prompt). No test files were available to upload.

features.name: Stage scrubber with playback and attention-flow overlay
features.general: Step or animate through ordered stages of a process while a marker shows each item's position at that stage on a shared map, optionally drawing what each state draws from
features.specific: Layer slider plus ▶/❚❚ and a 0.5×/1×/2× speed dropdown that move the current-layer marker of every visible run along its hidden-state trajectory over the density terrain; the 'attention flow' checkbox draws arcs from the current-layer state to earlier states
steps: drag the layer slider (or use arrow/End keys on it)
watch current-layer markers move over the terrain
choose a playback speed
press ▶ to animate, ❚❚ to pause at an interesting layer
tick 'attention flow' to draw arcs from the current-layer state

Show what each state draws information from
Compare two models of different size in one common readout space

features.name: Hover/pin state inspector card
features.general: Point at any data point on a plot to see its full record, click to pin it, press Esc to release
features.specific: State card with run · token, layer (fractional for interpolated or other-model states), entropy, nbhd preserved %, logit-lens top-k bars, nearest-token cosines, attn/mlp residual-write bar and, for decode tokens, decode-step probability; one state can be pinned at a time
steps: hover a trajectory state to preview its card
click to pin it ('PINNED · ESC TO CLEAR')
read readouts and fidelity
press Escape to clear and pick another state
serves_tasks: Inspect what one state represents at a given stage
Find individual points whose 2-D placement misrepresents their true neighbours
See how each newly generated item's state evolves and how likely it was
Compare two models of different size in one common readout space

re-check runs to overlay them
hover a prompt to read it in full
read the Hausdorff/DTW/shared row for each run versus A

features.name: Projection-fidelity readout with scene-level caveat panel
features.general: Report for each point how well its low-dimensional position keeps its real neighbours, and summarise how much of the plot is affected

switch to 'open' for an unsupervised camera
